summary: 14 games, none started yet; first tip-offs at 8:00 am Malaysia time. Corrections and news since last check: Jayson Tatum is OUT (rest) for Boston, and Giannis Antetokounmpo now plays for Miami (probable vs the Clippers), so the earlier Bucks and Heat notes were wrong and Miami is now about a 2-to-1 favourite. Jalen Johnson (ATL) and Alex Sarr (WAS) are both still questionable. Prices now match my estimates closely, so I have removed all three earlier picks: no value bet at 2.00+ right now. Watch the final injury report and starting lineups about 30 minutes before tip; if Jalen Johnson is ruled out and Sarr plays, Washington near 2.20 becomes interesting.

games.note: Hawks -2.5; Polymarket has Washington about 45%. Jalen Johnson (ankle) and Alex Sarr (knee) both questionable and could miss a second straight game; Atlanta also without Jock Landale.
Pistons -135 / 76ers +120 (2.20). Detroit still without Jalen Duren and Isaiah Joe; Embiid available. The market has priced Duren's absence in, so the earlier Philadelphia pick is withdrawn.
Charlotte about a 59% favourite. Kon Knueppel and Coby White listed probable, likely on minutes limits; Brooklyn without Egor Demin.
Jayson Tatum OUT (rest); Payton Pritchard questionable (shoulder). Celtics still -493 / Bucks +378, spread 10.5. Milwaukee is 1-6.
Knicks about 84% on Polymarket. Josh Hart (ankle) questionable; Nic Claxton (CHI, hamstring) questionable.
Pelicans -5.5, about 70% on Polymarket. Utah without Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic; Mo Bamba questionable.
Grizzlies -6.5. Indiana without Haliburton and McConnell; Zubac, Oubre and Toppin questionable. Memphis without Scotty Pippen Jr.

Thunder -142, spread 2.5. OKC without Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace; Caruso reportedly back. Cleveland without Tyson and Watson. Price on Cleveland (~2.20-2.30) is about fair, so no pick.
Anthony Edwards out (knee surgery). Rockets about 72% (spread 8.5); Capela questionable, Steven Adams out. Minnesota near 3.55 is about fair, no pick.
Nuggets about 66%. Toronto without Kawhi Leonard; Jakob Poeltl questionable after missing two games.
Portland -2.5 even with Ja Morant out (hamstring). Suns' Jordan Goodwin questionable.
Spurs about 82%, spread 11.5. Kyrie Irving off the injury report; Dallas without Lively and Christie, Aldama questionable.
Lakers -11.5, about 83% on Polymarket. Sacramento without Keegan Murray, Raynaud, Cardwell and Simmons. My earlier 29% for the Kings was too high.
Correction: Giannis Antetokounmpo is with Miami now (probable, wrist). Heat about 67%. Clippers without Ingram and Beal; Hachimura and Derrick Jones Jr. day-to-day.
